text:
Lina: heads up — can we get a small dashboard to track GPU allocator churn + nvlink/pci errors? noticed a few noisy incidents this week where pods got OOMed but node memory looked 'ok' :confused:

Lina: idea is: per-GPU allocation failures, memory fragmentation metric, nvlink error bursts, and power-cap spikes correlated with evictions. want a compact 4-panel row we can drop into fleet overview.

AJ: yup makes sense. can you sketch the PromQL you want? we should avoid super expensive queries across 2000 GPUs.

Lina: here's a starter set I used in ad-hoc queries — please sanity-check and optimize before adding to dashboard:
```
# allocation failure rate per GPU (5m)
sum by (gpu_id) (rate(gpu_alloc_failures_total[5m]))

# per-GPU memory utilization
avg by (gpu_id) (gpu_memory_used_bytes / gpu_memory_total_bytes)

# NVLink / PCIe error bursts (counter)
sum by (gpu_id) (increase(nvidia_nvlink_error_total[5m]))

# GPU power cap events (boolean-ish)
max by (gpu_id) (gpu_power_limit_watts)  # compare against expected node SKU cap
```

Matt: a couple of notes — replace raw per-gpu cardinality with `topk(25, ...)` in panels or rollup into rack / pool for the fleet overview. also prefer `irate()` for counters with short windows to reduce noise.

Priya: for fragmentation: we don't have a perfect metric but we can approximate with allocation latency spike + free_span_count dropping. sample query I used:
```
# allocation latency p99 (ms)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(gpu_alloc_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, gpu_id)) * 1000

# free span count (proxy for fragmentation)
sum by (gpu_id) (gpu_free_span_count)
```

Lina: nice — panel layout suggestion: 1) allocation failure rate (topk 20) timeseries heatmap, 2) p99 alloc latency histogram, 3) nvlink_error bursts (bar/points) with annotation for driver reloads, 4) power cap vs expected (gauge + sparkline).

AJ: for alerts — propose two alerts to start: 
- `gpu_alloc_churn` fires if top 5 GPUs have alloc_failure_rate > 0.1/s for 10m 
- `gpu_nvlink_spike` fires if increase(nvidia_nvlink_error_total[5m]) > 3 on any gpu for 5m
Make them P1->P2 on the escalation policy.

Matt: also add an SLO noise guard: only alert if the GPU belongs to `prod` tenant label or node is in `gpu-prod` pool. otherwise we'll get noisy alerts from dev clusters.

Priya: one more — add a dashboard template var: `$pool` and `$rack` so engineers can filter to a rack when debugging thermal/power patterns.

Lina: Deployment note — I'll open a tiny PR with the JSON panels. AJ can review the queries for cost. Matt can add the alerting YAML to ops repo.

sre-bot: reminder: dashboard JSON must have `datasource: Prometheus` and avoid panels with unbounded `group_left` joins — CI will reject heavy queries.

AJ: ack, I'll run the queries against the dev prometheus and check step/series cardinality. will push optimizations (topk + label_drop).

Matt: if anyone wants, I can add an annotation that shows `powercap` enforcement events from inventory (we have an exported `node_gpu_powercap_applied` gauge). makes correlation easier.

Lina: perfect — thanks all. I'll create the PR and tag @AJ @Matt for review. goal: land in next 3 days so support has the panels for the oncall rotation. :rocket:
